news.headline: ​Market Trading Guide: ITC, ICICI Bank among 5 stock recommendations for Muhurat trading session
news.summary: Nifty reclaims 25,000 on a seven-session winning streak backed by robust Q2 earnings and firm macro data. Market analysts recommend top 5 stocks, including ITC, ICICI Bank, SBI, Force Motors, and M&M, for the upcoming Muhurat trading session based on strong technical breakout structures.

news.headline: Muhurat trading: Sensex up 320 pts, Nifty crosses 25,100; Tata Steel, Sun Pharma among top gainers
Diwali turned lucky for these 8 stocks! Investors' wealth more than doubled, returns soar up to 191%
news.summary: Despite the Nifty 50 declining nearly 3% since Diwali 2025, eight BSE 500 stocks more than doubled investors' wealth. Data from ACE Equities shows Aditya Infotech, HFCL, and Welspun Corp leading the rally with returns of up to 191% over the past year.

news.headline: Muhurat Trading 2026 Highlights | Closing Bell: Sensex ends Muhurat Trading marginally lower, Nifty below 25,000; Divi's Labs surges 7%
Lower crude, global stability to drive market growth in new Samvat: ANMI President Kamlesh Shroff
news.summary: India's macroeconomic environment is poised for robust growth, projected at over seven percent, bolstering equity markets. With falling crude oil prices, the rupee may strengthen, drawing foreign investors. Retail and domestic institutional investors are actively engaging despite foreign investor withdrawal. Clarity from recent US elections is predicted to alleviate geopolitical tensions, boosting business confidence and anticipation of renewed foreign investment in Indian markets.

news.headline: Indian economy to grow faster, foreign capital returning to markets: NSE CEO Ashishkumar Chauhan
news.summary: India's economy is projected to experience faster growth due to strong macroeconomic fundamentals and increased foreign interest. The Managing Director of the National Stock Exchange highlighted that the country is managing fiscal pressures effectively. Domestic financial savings have significantly increased, reaching nearly USD 1.4 trillion annually. Furthermore, foreign institutional investors are showing renewed enthusiasm for Indian markets ahead of the new Samvat year.
